changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: No query leads with event_type: each one that filters on it also filters on the workspace, the repository or the target, which the workspace, workspace-target, repository and target indexes serve. Every activity write still updated this index. CONCURRENTLY drops it without blocking writes.
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_activity_event_type_time

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_activity_event_type_time; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_activity_event_type_time ON activity_event (event_type, occurred_at)
